segments.text: Desk memo, night shift. Desk time, central European, all the way through.
Ten twenty, before midnight. Tram three boards froze, feed refresh stalled at the depot panel.
Ten fifty-seven, before midnight. Restarted by hand, tram three boards back.
One twenty. Tram three boards froze again, feed refresh stalled at the depot panel.
One fifty-seven. Restarted by hand, tram three boards back.
Two twenty. Tram three boards froze again, feed refresh stalled at the depot panel.
Two fifty-seven. Restarted by hand, tram three boards back.
Three twenty. Tram three boards froze again, feed refresh stalled at the depot panel.
Three thirty. Tram one, signal hold at the river crossing, cleared.
Three fifty-seven. Restarted by hand, tram three boards back.
Four twenty. Same again on tram three, feed refresh stalled at the depot panel.
Four fifty-seven. Restarted by hand, tram three boards back.
Handing over. Radio four is crackling again.
